templates.source: https://support.oncamgrandeye.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360017723940-Evolution-05-05-Mini-Connecting-to-the-camera-RTSP-stream — Oncam Support Centre 'Evolution 05 / 05-Mini - Connecting to the camera RTSP stream': 4MP rtsp://camera_ip_address:554/h264/video.sdp?camera=13 (also in the EVO-05 User Manual OG-003719)

notes: Guide covers the Evolution 05 / 05 Mini family (EVO-05-*), the most common Oncam line. Other lines use different documented paths, set per record: Evolution 12 (EVO-12-*) rtsp://<ip>:<port>/h264/video.sdp?name=FE1 (https://support.oncamgrandeye.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360015457780-Evolution-12-Connecting-to-Camera-RTSP-Stream); Evolution 180 (EVO-180-*) rtsp://<ip>:<port>/video.sdp?name=FE1 (https://support.oncamgrandeye.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360017724480-Evolution-180-Connecting-to-RTSP-Streams); C-Series C-08/C-12 rtsp://<ip>:554/h264/video.sdp?name=MP1..MP4 (also /h265/ and /MJPEG/) per media profile (https://support.oncamgrandeye.com/hc/en-gb/articles/14214670218386-C-Series-Connecting-to-RTSP-Streams). H.264 RTSP port is 554; Evolution multicast uses port 8556 /h264/multicast.sdp.
